title: Vastoler — supervisory work as possible detriment
shortTitle: Vastoler — supervisory work as possible detriment
summary: The assigned boundary page reports an appellate concern that job-related stress and continued service had been overlooked in evaluating reliance.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

Only the continuation of the discussion is assigned here. It asks whether reliance can include more than an immediate salary loss and relates the case to reform proposals. Earlier facts and the full opinion are not reconstructed.
